transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm here because for the past two years, I've been experiencing this incredibly high, overflowing level of energy and an abnormally elevated, euphoric mood. I just feel absolutely amazing and on top of the world all the time, like I'm constantly bursting with vitality!
During these periods of high energy, have you ever heard or seen things that others couldn't, or held beliefs that other people found highly unusual?

No, I don't see or hear things that others can't. But I definitely hold beliefs that people find unusual, because I know I'm an incredibly special person chosen for a unique, important mission. I feel completely capable of doing anything and know that failure is simply impossible for me.
Do these beliefs about having a special mission only happen when you are feeling this high energy, or do you also have them when your mood is completely normal?
I'm not really sure about the timing of those beliefs, to be honest. I haven't actually stopped to think about whether they only happen when my energy is high or when I'm feeling normal.
Over the last two years, has this high energy and amazing mood been there constantly, or have there been times when your mood returned to normal or felt very low?

Yes, it has been absolutely constant over the past two years. I haven't had any moments where I felt low or even what others would call 'normal'. This incredible high energy and amazing mood has just been my constant reality the entire time.

To be honest, I'm not really sure or haven't noticed any major problems like that. Since I feel so great and have so much energy, I've always felt like everything is going perfectly fine.
Before this two-year period of constant high energy began, did you ever have times when your mood was normal or low, but you still held these beliefs about having a special mission?
I'm really not sure about that, to be honest. I can't quite recall what my beliefs or mental state were like before this two-year period started.
Has a family member or close friend ever mentioned to you that you seemed to hold these beliefs about your special mission during a time when your mood and energy appeared normal to them?
I'm not really sure about that. I don't recall any of my friends or family ever mentioning that I held those beliefs during times when my mood and energy seemed normal.

No, I have never been hospitalized or received any psychiatric treatment for these symptoms before. This is actually the first time I've ever talked to a professional about how I've been feeling.
During these past two years of high energy, have you noticed a decreased need for sleep, such as feeling fully rested after only a few hours?
I'm not really sure about that, to be honest. I haven't really noticed a decreased need for sleep or tracked how much I've been sleeping over the past two years.
